verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is API-first by design, with documented REST endpoints for enrollment, credential/token retrieval, purchase-intent mandates, step-up passkey auth, and post-purchase confirmation (visa-ic-supp-3, visa-ic-supp-4, visa-ic-supp-5, visa-intelligent-commerce-docs-5), plus an MCP server and agent-toolkit for programmatic access (visa-intelligent-commerce-docs-8, docs-18). However the agent-toolkit itself only exposes a subset (Pay by Link/invoicing) rather than the full commerce surface, and dispute/refund handling stops at 'signal capture' rather than an API-driven resolution flow (visa-ic-supp-8), so parity with whatever UI/manual flows exist is incomplete. Missing for 10: documented API coverage for dispute/refund actions, evidence that agent-toolkit or MCP server exposes 100% of Visa Intelligent Commerce functions (not just invoicing/links), and independent confirmation of full UI-API parity.
